title: Ranked match record
description: One match record from a rankewd season JSON Lines file. The schema covers the shared record shape and the observed season-to-season field variations.

tag.description: Optional source tag associated with the match.

vod.description: Optional video-on-demand references. Sampled records had empty arrays; item shape is left open because the dataset samples do not establish it.

date.description: Match start timestamp as Unix seconds.

type.description: Source match-type code. The dataset does not include a code-to-name mapping.

changes.description: Per-player rating changes recorded for this match. This array may be empty.

decayed.description: Whether the source marks the match or rating as decayed.

players.description: Players included in the match record.

beginner.description: Whether the source marks this as a beginner match.

category.description: Source category code, such as ANY or ENTER_NETHER. Values are kept open for categories not present in the sample.

gameMode.description: Optional source game-mode label. This property is absent in older season records.

seedType.description: Seed or starting-structure category, when supplied.

botSource.description: Bot/source label, when supplied. Sampled records contained null.

forfeited.description: Whether the match record is marked as forfeited.

timelines.description: Recorded match events. Event names are source strings and are not an exhaustive enum.

spectators.description: Spectator entries. Sampled arrays were empty, so the element shape is not constrained.

completions.description: Completed runs associated with the match. This array may be empty.

replayExist.description: Replay-availability flag used by most sampled records.

replayExists.description: Legacy spelling of the replay-availability field, observed once as an integer. The dataset does not establish its full value range.

uuid.description: UUID written as 32 hexadecimal characters without hyphens.

season.description: Season rank, or null when no rank is recorded.

allTime.description: All-time rank, or null when no rank is recorded.

id.description: Opaque seed identifier, or null when the seed is unavailable.

nether.description: Bastion location type for the seed, when available.

endTowers.description: Four integer tower values when the seed includes End tower data; null when unavailable.

overworld.description: Overworld starting-structure label, or null when unavailable.

time.description: Recorded result or completion time in milliseconds.

uuid.description: UUID associated with the result, or null when there is no associated player.

change.description: Signed rating change, or null when the source has no value.

eloRate.description: Rating value associated with the change, or null when unavailable.

country.description: Lowercase two-letter country code as supplied by the source, or null. The source may use non-standard codes.

eloRank.description: Player rating rank, or null when unavailable.

eloRate.description: Player rating, or null when unavailable.

roleType.description: Source player-role code. The dataset does not include a code-to-name mapping.

time.description: Event time in milliseconds on the match clock.

type.description: Source event identifier, for example an advancement name or projectelo.timeline event.

uuid.description: UUID of the player associated with this event.

data.description: Optional event-specific payload. Its meaning depends on the event type.

uuid.description: UUID of the player associated with the completion.
